decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and cheap to keep, its demand remains uncertain enough to warrant keeping the option open.
As a responsive template complementary to hosting, it has unresolved market prospects and low maintenance cost, so keep.
Premium support builds directly on existing service capabilities and is inexpensive to retain while demand uncertainty remains.
The version management tool leverages established technical know-how and has its own page, indicating ongoing option value with low abandonment pressure.
Although distant from the core, its legal-tool market potential is still uncertain and the option can be kept at moderate cost while monitoring results.
